halo_offset.description: Template halo-position slider, 0..1, default 0.5; halo Y = (value - 0.5) * 800 in template skeleton units.

character_scale.description: Template import slider, 0..1, default 0.5. The template first normalizes the PNG height to 4769 skeleton units, then applies this root scale; this is not a multiplier of the original PNG pixel size. Use smaller values for close-up portraits.

character_y_offset.description: Template vertical-position slider, 0..1, default 0.5; root Y = 113 + (value - 0.5) * 800 in template skeleton units.

notes: IDs are opaque persistent values; request aliases are local to one batch.
Every edit checks the final candidate graph. Unknown fields are rejected by the runtime.
UI and MCP share one working copy. Save persists the entire inspected revision.
File content versions and business revisions are distinct.
starting_position is derived and read-only; use ending_position and appear for movement.
Resource manifest transactions are independent of project graph saves and UI graph undo.
Project saves write .aap2 and a marked legacy .aap. An unmarked .aap changed since the last primary save is read automatically; opening never rewrites either file.
